headline: Prime SE swell and a glassy dawn — the early session is on.
today: Light E wind at dawn (2mph) over a prime-angle SE swell to 2ft is the clean window today; get on it before the SSE-S cross-on fills in around mid-morning. Not huge but the direction and glass make it worthwhile if you're local to it. Log or fish for the dawn, then it turns to soft cross-on mush.

daysToWatch.note: Biggest of the run at 2.4-2.6ft, good SSE angle, glassy at dawn. Fish or shortboard the early window before the SSW onshore builds through the day.
N offshore in the morning cleans up a 1.9-2ft good-angle swell. Solid early session before the SW cross-on evening.
